temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn for several days, which is uncharacteristic; when Carolyn asks, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed by work and personal matters.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is normally engaging and sociable; her recent quietness is unusual and may mean something is wrong.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Marilyn confirms she is dealing with work and personal stress, though she does not share details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is overwhelmed and may need support, but she may not be ready to disclose more.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer support and let Marilyn know Carolyn is available to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn was curt in a later interaction, leaving Carolyn confused and hurt; when Carolyn shares her own tough experiences, Marilyn apologizes, says she appreciates it, and explains it has been a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is overwhelmed and likely appreciates Carolyn's earlier check-in; Carolyn's support may be helping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Marilyn's curtness may not be personal; her apology and explanation suggest stress is affecting her behavior.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is not upset with Carolyn, is having a hard week, and values Carolyn's openness and support.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initially confused and hurt, then reassured and empathetic.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Clear up any misunderstanding and continue showing support without overstepping.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn responds positively to Carolyn's openness and enthusiastically accepts Carolyn's invitation to a small weekend gathering.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes she and Marilyn have cleared the misunderstanding and is hopeful about their budding friendship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Marilyn's acceptance shows she is open to spending time with Carolyn socially and deepening the friendship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is interested in a closer friendship, and the bond between them is strengthening.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Strengthen the friendship by hosting the gathering and including Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Carolyn perceives Marilyn as still maintaining professional distance at the bank; when Carolyn raises it, Marilyn says she did not realize it, apologizes, and agrees to talk about improving collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes their friendship is growing through friendly outside-of-work interactions and hopes this closeness will carry into work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Carolyn learns Marilyn may be keeping a professional distance at work, but Marilyn did not intend to make Carolyn feel that way and is willing to address it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: There is a workplace distance to resolve, but Marilyn is cooperative and open to improving their work dynamic.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Disappointed and confused, then cautiously relieved and somewhat optimistic.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Address the work dynamic directly and work toward better professional collaboration.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their private meeting, Carolyn proposes teaming up on the new project; Marilyn agrees enthusiastically, says she is glad they had the talk, and looks forward to working more closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes they cleared the air and now better understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Marilyn's positive response confirms she values the improved understanding and wants to collaborate more closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn believes their partnership is stronger and that they can work well together on the project.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Team up with Marilyn on the new project proposal and continue building a close working partnership.
